criteria.requirement: Add anytree.util.fold_subtree(node, reducer) and NodeResultMap. Use iterative postorder, call reducer once per node with (actual_node, tuple_of_ordered_child_results), and return a read-only mapping keyed by node identity, including unhashable or equal-but-distinct NodeMixin subclasses. Retain references, preserve child order and original nodes, follow children only (not SymlinkNode targets), propagate reducer exceptions and reject structural cycles/repeated identities. Deep trees must not depend on Python recursion limits. Do not attach result attributes or caches to nodes.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
